q: In this position paper, we argue that, to further advance SE agents, we need to move beyond reactive behavior toward a structured, state-aware, and execution-grounded reasoning.
r: EC3: short position paper (about 4 pages, no evaluation) on SE agent reasoning.

q: we construct a 30-task benchmark on the FastAPI RealWorld example app, partitioned into three groups by dependency discoverability
r: Include: controlled comparison of three conditions on Claude Code with repeated trials (258), new task taxonomy and metric, feature-level tasks on an application.

q: This paper presents a systematic analysis of human-centric conventions under agentic pressure and proposes a key design principle: semantic density optimization
r: IC1: code conventions and log-format token economy, not SDD, context files or coding-agent evaluation.

q: This paper presents RL Developer Memory, a local-first, Model Context Protocol (MCP)-native developer-memory architecture for RL coding agents.
r: Include: persistent memory mechanism for coding agents (group b, not narrowed by EC5/EC6).

q: The Cursor overlay ships .cursor/rules/wiki-*.mdc with an always-apply memory rule
r: Include: LLM-wiki memory template with agent overlays (CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules) for coding agents; borderline, context mechanism (group b).

q: We independently re-implement the DirectSolve variant and evaluate it on the SWEbench Verified benchmark.
r: EC6: issue repair on SWE-bench Verified, always excluded.

q: the first systematic empirical study of visual repository representations for MLLM-based software engineering agents on repository-level issue resolution
r: EC6: issue resolution on SWE-bench Verified, always excluded.

q: Project + Technical Memory written to durable, versioncontrolled files that survive across sessions, devices and environments.
r: Include: file-based persistent memory (MEMORY.md, CLAUDE.md) for a local coding agent (group b); a proof of concept with no evaluation, kept per group b.

q: This paper argues that the central challenge is coordination: deciding who does what, when, and under whose authority.
r: IC1: conceptual argument on coordination and governance in agentic SE; neither SDD, context files nor evaluation of coding agents.

q: We also introduced AES-Bench, a multilingual benchmark that contains 112 real-world instances across 9 programming languages.
r: EC6: automated environment setup is not code development.
